label: A browser extension I installed
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I want it to work on the sites I use it on. I did not install it so that it could see every page I visit, act inside the accounts I am logged into, or send what it sees anywhere.

notes.read.record.browsing: the want is ‘the sites I chose’; the grant is every page — the same capability at two different reaches, which is what the reduction (‘on click, or on a list of sites’) narrows

provenance.note: Promoted from mandates/browser-extension-i-installed.json. `unstated` is computed here as the primitives the mandate names neither way; the pack leaves it implicit. A mandate is elicited, not measured: these are first drafts written to be argued with.
